method: Built-in image generation using each repository-owned base sheet as identity/style reference; generated while the workspace was unavailable, recovered unchanged for packing.

contract.scale: Arambai/Konnik retain cavalry body height 60; elephant/wagon walking height and width fit their actual base atlas envelope; each retains base walking cadence.

sources.authoringBrief: Gold-banded ivory headwrap, reinforced lamellar vest, royal-blue shoulder cloak/waist/saddle panels, woven dart basket; walk with dart, release with empty throwing hand at frame 12.
Preserve the game's spear and gold-chevron blue kite shield, grey-brown horse, silver/gold armour, short blue crest and cloak; full spear thrust at frame 12.

Grey Asian elephant, ivory tusks, one mahout, reinforced silver/gold forehead/neck plates and broad blue caparison. Eight heavy walks and head/tusk attack. Generated peak head/tusk strike is frame 11 rather than the requested frame 12; pack the observed pose.

Grey Asian elephant, ivory tusks, reinforced blue/gold drape, low reinforced howdah with one silver-armoured bowman. Whole recurve bow/string, eight walks, release at frame 12; flying arrow remains game-rendered.

Preserve existing wheeled launcher cart and operator; reinforced dark oak, silver/gold hull and rims, gold hubs, broad blue panels/banners. Eight rotating-wheel poses and operating/firing sequence. Small attached neutral orange flash at frame 12.
